author: Stuart Ham
title: Traders Sell Shares of Apple (AAPL) on Strength (AAPL)
text:
Tweet 
Traders sold shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on strength during trading on Wednesday. $969.52 million flowed into the stock on the tick-up and $1,370.51 million flowed out of the stock on the tick-down, for a money net flow of $400.99 million out of the stock. Of all stocks tracked, Apple had the 0th highest net out-flow for the day. Apple traded up $0.46 for the day and closed at $167.43 
AAPL has been the subject of several research reports. Mizuho set a $160.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “hold” rating in a research note on Wednesday, October 18th. Vetr downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $178.34 target price for the company. in a research note on Friday, December 1st. UBS Group set a $190.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 5th. Needham & Company LLC raised their target price on Apple from $175.00 to $200.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, November 3rd. Finally, Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and issued a $205.00 target price (up from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 23rd. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, thirteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-five have assigned a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $203.15. Get Apple alerts: 
The company has a market capitalization of $861,430.00, a P/E ratio of 18.26, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.36 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a current ratio of 1.28 and a quick ratio of 1.23. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.75 by $0.14. Apple had a return on equity of 36.29% and a net margin of 21.09%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business earned $3.36 EPS. The company’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.13 earnings per share for the current year. 
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th will be issued a $0.63 dividend. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.50%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 27.42%. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at the SEC website . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 10,368 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, November 24th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.68, for a total transaction of $1,811,082.24. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 81,560 shares in the company, valued at approximately $14,246,900.80. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155 in the last ninety days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders. 
Several large investors have recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Welch Group LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 3.8% during the 4th quarter. Welch Group LLC now owns 21,342 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,612,000 after acquiring an additional 782 shares during the period. Portland Global Advisors LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 3.1% during the 4th quarter. Portland Global Advisors LLC now owns 15,522 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,627,000 after acquiring an additional 472 shares during the period. Family Legacy Inc. raised its holdings in Apple by 90.0% during the 4th quarter. Family Legacy Inc. now owns 19,947 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,376,000 after acquiring an additional 9,447 shares during the period. Kovack Advisors Inc. bought a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter valued at $23,072,000. Finally, Allied Investment Advisors LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter valued at $5,411,000. 60.26% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.

The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
